description: Basic arithmetic on complex numbers in algebraic form: sum, difference, product, and quotient of two given complex numbers.

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math textbook, Chapter 1 (complex numbers, algebraic form) — exercises only
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-25

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given } z_1=3+2i \text{ and } z_2=-1+3i. \text{ Compute } z_1+z_2. \quad \text{(a) } 4+5i \quad \text{(b) } 4-i \quad \text{(c) } 2+5i \quad \text{(d) } 2+6i \quad \text{(e) another answer}
\text{Given } z_1=-3-2i \text{ and } z_2=-5+i. \text{ Compute } z_1-z_2. \quad \text{(a) } 2-i \quad \text{(b) } 2-3i \quad \text{(c) } -8-3i \quad \text{(d) } 2+3i \quad \text{(e) another answer}
\text{Given } z_1=1+3i \text{ and } z_2=2-i. \text{ Compute } z_1 z_2. \quad \text{(a) } -1+5i \quad \text{(b) } 4-5i \quad \text{(c) } 4+5i \quad \text{(d) } -4+5i \quad \text{(e) another answer}
exercises.technique: Multiplication of complex numbers using i^2=-1.

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given } z_1=5-i \text{ and } z_2=1-i. \text{ Compute } z_1+z_2,\ z_1-z_2,\ z_1 z_2 \text{ and } \frac{z_1}{z_2}.
exercises.technique: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division (multiply by conjugate of denominator) of complex numbers.

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given } z_1=3+7i \text{ and } z_2=5+2i. \text{ Compute } z_1+z_2,\ z_1-z_2,\ z_1 z_2 \text{ and } \frac{z_1}{z_2}.
exercises.technique: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division (multiply by conjugate of denominator) of complex numbers.

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given } z_1=3+2i \text{ and } z_2=2+4i. \text{ Compute the algebraic forms of } z_1+z_2,\ z_1-z_2,\ 2z_2 \text{ and } 2z_1+z_2.
exercises.technique: Addition, subtraction, and scalar multiplication of complex numbers.
